# Events API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/events.json</code></div>

A simple named-event bus: subscribe, emit and unsubscribe.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.events.on`

`on(eventName, callback) -> integer`

Subscribes a callback to a named event.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `eventName` | string | Event name. |
| `callback` | function | Called with the arguments given to emit. |

**Returns:** `integer` — Handler handle for off.

**Example**

```lua
local h = caffeine.events.on('hit', function(dmg) end)
```

### `caffeine.events.emit`

`emit(eventName, ...)`

Calls every handler of the event in registration order. A handler error is logged and does not stop the others.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `eventName` | string | Event name. |
| `...` | any | Arguments passed to each handler. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.events.emit('hit', 10)
```

### `caffeine.events.off`

`off(handle)`

Removes a handler.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `handle` | integer | Handle returned by on. |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.events.off(h)
```
